verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server that answers sync-status questions such as "was my last postgres sync successful" and "are any of my connections broken". Setting FIVETRAN_SCOPE to read/write unlocks write operations, and the REST API manages pipelines programmatically, so status checks and re-triggering are reachable by an agent. Diagnosis beyond flagging a broken connection is only implied, and no evidence names a sync-trigger call explicitly. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented sync/re-sync trigger via API or MCP, failure-diagnosis detail (error logs, failure reasons), and independent hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.
